ruleSet.name: reader
ruleSet.description: Rivulet app backend — RSS/Atom reader. Scaffold: SuperTokens auth reverse-proxy. Feed/item/refresh pipelines land with later stories (bffless/apps#112+).

rules.description: Reverse-proxy SuperTokens auth endpoints (session, session/refresh, signout, oauth) to the CE backend so this subdomain app can refresh the sAccessToken session. forwardCookies carries the path-scoped sRefreshToken cookie. NOT the /_bffless/auth relay (that is reserved for cross-origin custom domains). See apps/reader/CONTEXT.md D11.
